wears rimless glasses and a fitted black suit that sits like a uniform

probability adjudication only offers incomplete near-term risk probabilities, costs or branches; standard portrait must not show a certain future, correct answer, fate threads or omniscient percentage meters
designAssumptions: lean Chinese man with precise short side-parted black hair, cool grey eyes and a controlled expression behind narrow rimless glasses
wears an impeccably fitted matte black suit, crisp white collared shirt, narrow black tie, straight trousers and plain black shoes
holds one small irregular polished black obsidian stone between the right thumb and index finger at chest height as if slowly turning it; left arm rests at his side
sceneConcept: A lean thirty-one-year-old Chinese risk assessor stands alone against a transparent background. Precise short side-parted black hair, cool grey eyes and narrow rimless glasses support a controlled expression. He wears an impeccably fitted matte black suit, crisp white collared shirt, narrow black tie, straight trousers and plain black shoes. One small irregular polished black obsidian stone rests between his right thumb and index finger at chest height as if he is slowly turning it, while his left arm remains at his side. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the stone opaque.
